payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of text-based games used in experiments, particularly CoinCollector and CookingWorld, along with a reference to a broader set of games from 'First TextWorld Problems'.

claims.text: Experiments were performed on the CoinCollector game, which is designed to benchmark exploration capabilities.
The CookingWorld games were used to evaluate the generalization capabilities of the proposed approach in text-based games.
The experiments also included 4,440 games from 'First TextWorld Problems' to demonstrate generalization ability.
